items.summary: The macro fund raised its iShares Bitcoin Trust stake 18.9% to 688,529 shares worth $22.9 million in Q2, while sharply cutting its call options—a shift from leveraged bets toward direct spot exposure.

items.title: SafePal Bitcoin Wallet Data Breach Stokes Fears of Physical Attacks
